verdict.rationale: The pack documents no power envelope (TGP/TDP figures) and no independent performance-per-watt testing for the RTX 5070 Ti. The TechPowerUp community item covers cooler noise and temperatures, which is adjacent to power efficiency but is not it. The only efficiency mention is a vague marketing phrase about AI workflows, with no power data.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
